title: Jagged Peppery Canadian Potato Hash
description: A peppery, gooey, adventurous Canadian dish featuring floury potatoes, double-fry-kfc, and raw-friendly ingredients, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Double-fry the diced potatoes in batches until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a large bowl, mix together the fried potatoes, black pepper, salt, garlic powder, and onion powder.
In a separate pan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the shredded cheese to the pan and stir until it is melted and gooey.
Add the melted cheese to the bowl with the potatoes and mix until well combined.
Transfer the potato mixture to a serving dish and top with chopped scallions.
Serve the hash hot and enjoy.
